name: Local & Secure Storage
description: Local & Secure Storage standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-RN-STORE applies.

rules.title: Use secure storage for credentials and sensitive secrets
rules.detail: Store refresh tokens/keys in Keychain/Keystore-backed storage; AsyncStorage is for non-sensitive application preferences/cache.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Use secure storage for credentials and sensitive secrets.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Use secure storage for credentials and sensitive secrets.

rules.title: Namespace and version persisted keys
rules.detail: Persisted client state uses stable names and migration/version logic so app upgrades do not silently misread old values.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Namespace and version persisted keys.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Namespace and version persisted keys.

rules.title: Define logout/account-switch cleanup
rules.detail: Remove credentials and user-scoped persisted/cache data when identity changes to prevent cross-user leakage.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Define logout/account-switch cleanup.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Define logout/account-switch cleanup.

rules.title: Bound cached/offline storage
rules.detail: Apply TTL/size/cleanup to cached data and avoid unbounded AsyncStorage/SQLite growth.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Bound cached/offline storage.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Bound cached/offline storage.

rules.title: Handle persistence failures without corrupting UI state
rules.detail: Reads/writes have fallback/error behavior and critical writes are verified or transactional where supported.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Handle persistence failures without corrupting UI state.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Handle persistence failures without corrupting UI state.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-RN-STORE applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Local & Secure Storage to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Local & Secure Storage is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Local & Secure Storage failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
